args.title: Include currency in dedupe key to avoid merging distinct transactions
args.body: File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts. The dedupeKey function builds its key from date, amount, and description only, so since 3.2.0 transactions that differ only by currency (e.g. the same date/amount/description in EUR vs USD) collide and one is dropped as a duplicate. Update dedupeKey to also include t.currency in the joined key so transactions with different currencies are no longer treated as the same transaction.
